title: Aubergine kali lehenga for a walima
concept_summary: A poised walima concept in an aubergine panelled kali lehenga whose vertical panels swing as they flare. Silver-grey zardozi and crystal work catch the light along the panel seams, and a matching aubergine dupatta is drawn over the head before trailing behind in a long sweep.

garment_breakdown.overall_form: A fitted choli over a kali-panelled lehenga skirt with a long trailing dupatta.
garment_breakdown.silhouette: Vertical tapering panels that hold close at the waist and swing wide at the hem.
garment_breakdown.drape_or_layering: The dupatta is taken over the head and then allowed to trail well behind the hem.
garment_breakdown.key_proportions: A close bodice and defined waist read against the swing of the panelled skirt.

colour_story.palette_summary: A deep aubergine ground worked in cool silver grey.
colour_story.placement: Aubergine carries the choli, skirt and dupatta alike, with silver grey drawn along the panel seams.
colour_story.rationale: A single deep tone keeps the panelled skirt reading as one sweep rather than many pieces.

fabrics_and_texture.finish_and_movement: A dense pile that deepens the aubergine and gives the panels their weight.
A fine open mesh that veils rather than covers and keeps the trail light.

embellishment_plan.density: A balanced amount of work following the panel seams and hem rather than filling the ground.
embellishment_plan.restraint_notes: Plain velvet is left between the seams so the panel structure stays readable.

coverage_and_drape.sleeves: Sleeve length is left to styling preference.
coverage_and_drape.neckline: A sweetheart neckline curved like the top of a heart.
coverage_and_drape.back_and_midriff: A covered back with the waist veiled in sheer net rather than left bare.
coverage_and_drape.head_covering: The dupatta is drawn up over the head before it trails behind.
coverage_and_drape.dupatta_or_saree_drape: A matching aubergine dupatta taken over the head and left to trail.

cultural_context.regional_direction: A broad Hyderabadi bridal influence guides the deep tone and the fine metalwork.
interpretation_notes: Offered as one broad direction rather than a rule for any single community.
safeguards: No family or regional custom is presented as the only correct approach to a walima.

styling_notes: Cool-toned jewellery echoes the silver work.
Keep the trail clear when the dupatta is drawn over the head.
construction_caveats: This is a concept visualisation, not a sewing pattern, and includes no measurements.
It does not guarantee that the garment can be constructed exactly as shown.
image_alt_text: A model in an aubergine panelled kali lehenga with silver-grey zardozi, a sweetheart neckline and a matching dupatta drawn over the head and trailing behind.
